title: Constant curvature characterized by asymptotic marked k-surface energy spectra
difficulty_reason: The source compares hyperbolic and ambient area measures along the cited equidistributing Kahn–Markovic sequence, uses a nonnegative normalized mean-curvature defect and a full-support limiting measure to force every leaf of the k-surface foliation to be totally umbilic, and then invokes the cited Leung–Nomizu axiom of 2-spheres. The authors provide the area-versus-energy argument and state the general p,q case follows by the displayed identity and the same argument; that concise source treatment is preserved.

compared.relation: Same fixed work Theorem 1.3 compares marked positive-energy spectra of two metrics on a closed hyperbolic manifold and concludes hyperbolic rigidity under a lower curvature bound. Theorem 1.5 considers one general closed negatively curved 3-manifold and equivalence between constant curvature and asymptotic normalized p- and q-energy spectra; full-support measure ingredients are shared.

source_disclosures: The authors explicitly cite Kahn–Markovic and Leung–Nomizu. Their general p,q conclusion is stated to follow by the displayed identity and the preceding argument; no additional proof or assumptions are inserted.
